 Job Description
 You will be a hands-on technical specialist within the team, delivering engineering, configuration and automation work across our Microsoft 365 estate and providing expert support to keep it secure and running smoothly.
 Microsoft 365 administration and support 
 Configure, administer and support Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams in line with agreed platform standards and designs. 
 Monitor the Microsoft 365 Message Center for upcoming changes and help assess their impact on users and services. 
 Support the technical rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot, including permissions reviews and oversharing remediation. 
 Endpoint and device management 
 Engineer and maintain Microsoft Intune for Windows, iOS and Android, covering configuration profiles, compliance policies, app deployment and update rings. 
 Drive Windows Autopilot provisioning and continuous improvement of the Windows 11 build and user experience. 
 Manage Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise deployment, update channels and add-in management. 
 Identity, security and compliance 
 Configure and support Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, multi-factor authentication, identity protection, group-based licensing and privileged access. 
 Implement Microsoft Purview capabilities such as sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, retention and eDiscovery in line with regulatory and business requirements. 
 Maintain alignment with recognised security baselines and frameworks, such as CIS benchmarks and Cyber Essentials Plus. 
 Automation and engineering practice 
 Automate administration and reporting with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK. 
 Maintain clear technical documentation, configuration baselines and change records, and follow ITIL-aligned change, incident and problem processes. 
 Leadership and service 
 Act as third-line escalation for complex Microsoft 365, identity and endpoint issues, leading root-cause analysis and lasting fixes. 
 Coach and mentor Digital Workspace Engineers, review their technical work and share knowledge across the wider Technology function. 
 Contribute technical design and estimates to projects, working closely with the Project Manager, Service Desk, Infrastructure and Security teams. 
 Engage with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical, well-adopted technology solutions. 
 Qualifications
 Substantial hands-on experience administering and engineering an enterprise Microsoft 365 environment. 
 Deep knowledge of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams, including permissions and external collaboration. 
 Strong experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot in a modern, cloud-first device management model. 
 Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or Windows 365 
 Solid understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and identity security principles. 
 Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and working with Microsoft Graph. 
 A track record of delivering technical changes in a regulated or security-conscious organisation, along with an ability to ensure solutions are secure by design.
